description: ===== Used 2024 Chevrolet Tahoe LS for sale in Hamburg, PA =====Introducing the 2024 Chevrolet Tahoe LS, a versatile full-size SUV designed for families and adventurers alike. With a robust 5.3-liter V8 engine producing 355 horsepower and 383 lb-ft of torque, this SUV offers impressive power and towing capacity, especially with the Max Trailering Package included. The Sterling Gray Metallic exterior complements a sleek black interior, providing a modern yet practical look. Weighing just 0.0960, this used Tahoe has logged 50,504 miles and features a 10-speed automatic transmission paired with a capable 4WD system, ensuring smooth performance across various terrains.This Chevrolet Tahoe LS is loaded with modern conveniences, making every drive enjoyable. It features Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth connectivity, and satellite radio readiness for entertainment on the go. The backup camera, lane keep assist, collision warning, and rear A/C keep safety and comfort at the forefront. Keyless entry, push start, and WiFi hotspot provide added convenience. The vehicle also boasts third-row seating, accommodating up to eight passengers comfortably, along with a tow package for hauling trailers or boats. The inclusion of all-weather floor liners (3-Row) and molded splash guards enhances interior protection, while the electronic trailer brake controller and extra cooling system boost its towing capabilities.==== 2024 Chevrolet Tahoe Safety and Security Features ====This Tahoe prioritizes safety with a comprehensive suite of features. It includes a rear seat reminder to prevent accidental oversight, front center airbags, and parking sensors at both front and rear for precise maneuvering. Four-wheel ABS enhances braking control, while anti-lockout power door locks prevent lock-ins. Auto-locking locks add security, and a programmable safety key allows customized access, giving owners peace of mind and confidence behind the wheel.==== 2024 Chevrolet Tahoe Entertainment and Technology Features ====Equipped with an 8-inch touchscreen infotainment system, the Tahoe offers seamless connectivity via myChevrolet with Connected Access and compatibility with Amazon Alexa. Hands-free voice-operated phone calls and radio enhance ease of use, while the engine start and cabin preconditioning functions can be controlled remotely through compatible apps. The vehicle's smart device integration supports app marketplace access, enabling owners to personalize their experience. Electronic messaging assistance, both read and voice-operated, ensures staying connected is safe and simple while on the road.==== 2024 Chevrolet Tahoe Performance Features ====Performance is at the core of this SUV's design, with features like auto start/stop technology that helps improve fuel efficiency. The 4WD system is part-time with an on-demand setting, allowing drivers to switch between two-wheel and four-wheel drive as needed. A limited slip differential at the rear optimizes traction in challenging conditions, and the electronic 4WD selector provides quick, easy control. These features combine to deliver dependable performance whether on city streets or off-road adventures.

With only 32,256 miles on the odometer, this vehicle boasts a striking orange exterior that turns heads wherever you go. Powered by a supercharged 5.0-liter V8 engine delivering 518 horsepower and 461 lb-ft of torque, it offers exhilarating performance paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD for superior handling. The Range Rover Autobiography is equipped with premium features such as leather seats, cooled and heated comfort options, a sunroof/moonroof, and a sophisticated navigation system. Modern conveniences like Bluetooth, a Wi-Fi hotspot, premium audio with 1700 watts and 28 speakers, and a 10-inch infotainment screen ensure a refined driving experience. Whether commuting or exploring, this SUV provides ample seating for five with rear heated seats and rear A/C, making every ride comfortable. Its blend of luxury, power, and technology makes it an exceptional choice for discerning drivers seeking a used vehicle that stands out. This Range Rover also comes equipped with a suite of advanced safety and security features designed to keep you protected. Traffic sign recognition with adaptive speed limiting helps manage your speed in real-time, while additional traffic sign recognition enhances awareness. Parking sensors at the front and rear, along with parking assist, aid in tight spots. The vehicle features four-wheel ABS, cornering brake control, and emergency braking preparation for optimal safety. Anti-lock door locks prevent lockouts, and auto-locking locks add security. Off-road driving assist with hill ascent capabilities ensures confidence in challenging terrain, making it suitable for both city and off-road adventures. 2019 Land Rover Range Rover Safety and Security Features The safety package includes traffic sign recognition with adaptive speed limiting, aiding in maintaining safe speeds based on road signs. Front and rear parking sensors assist with maneuvering, complemented by parking assist for added convenience. The vehicle features four-wheel ABS and cornering brake control to enhance braking stability, along with emergency braking preparation. Power door locks are equipped with anti-lockout and auto-locking functions, providing security and peace of mind. Off-road driving assist with hill ascent support ensures confident handling on steep inclines, making this Range Rover suitable for diverse driving conditions. 2019 Land Rover Range Rover Entertainment and Technology Features Entertainment is delivered through a premium 28-speaker surround sound system boasting 1700 watts, ensuring rich, immersive audio. The dual rear video monitors and a 10-inch infotainment screen provide entertainment options for rear passengers and driver convenience. A DVD player adds versatility, while HD radio and voice-operated radio enhance connectivity. The 10-inch video monitor located at the rear offers additional viewing options, making every journey engaging and enjoyable. 2019 Land Rover Range Rover Performance Features Performance features include an active air suspension system that adapts to driving conditions for a smooth ride. Electronic suspension control and driver-adjustable ride and height settings allow for customization based on your preferences. The engine's auto start/stop system improves efficiency, while the electronic 4WD selector offers high and low modes for versatile traction. Self-leveling suspension ensures consistent ride quality, and locking differentials at the center and rear provide enhanced off-road capability, making this Range Rover ready for any adventure.

2.0L Turbocharged Engine with 48-Volt Mild Hybrid System: Delivers smooth, efficient performance with enhanced responsiveness.

4MATIC All-Wheel Drive: Mercedes-Benz intelligent all-wheel drive provides outstanding traction and confidence in changing road conditions.

Burmester Surround Sound System: Premium audio performance with immersive sound quality throughout the cabin.

Panorama Sunroof: Expansive glass roof creates an open, airy cabin for every passenger.

Surround View Camera: A 360-degree camera system makes parking and maneuvering effortless.

Heated & Ventilated Front Seats: Exceptional year-round comfort for both driver and front passenger.

KEYLESS-GO: Convenient keyless entry with push-button start and hands-free power liftgate functionality.

Paired with a smooth 9G-TRONIC 9-speed automatic transmission and Mercedes-Benz's advanced 4MATIC all-wheel drive system, the GLE 350 delivers refined acceleration, exceptional ride comfort, and confident capability in every season.
